entities.name: Torbran
entities.description: A red-bearded dwarf noble from Eldraine, Thane of the Red Fell clan, who wields a massive axe.

entities.name: Red Fell
entities.description: The dwarvish clan Torbran leads as Thane.

entities.name: Court of Embereth
entities.description: Court whose camaraderie appeals to some dwarves, who compete at the Burning Yard.

entities.name: Irencrag
entities.description: A stone whose taunts insulted Torbran's weapon, which knights must strike to claim knighthood.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: A faerie in love with Ayara who stole Torbran's ring.

entities.name: Ayara
entities.description: Now-compleat Phyrexianized figure loved by Rankle.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian force that invaded Eldraine.

events.summary: Torbran travels to Embereth to compete for knighthood but refuses to strike the Irencrag and returns to the Wilds.
New Phyrexia invades Eldraine; Torbran escapes compleation and plans to attack Castle Locthwain.
Torbran rescues Rankle from a Phyrexian attack and takes him along.
events.quote: he rescued Rankle from a Phyrexian attack

events.summary: Rankle steals Torbran's wishing ring and wastes two wishes; his third wish, a rain of love potion, defeats the Phyrexian force.
events.quote: Rankle's third wish - a rain of love potion - ended up singlehandedly defeating the Phyrexian force

relations.quote: the current Thane of the dwarvish clan of Red Fell

relations.note: Rankle is in love with Ayara
relations.quote: the faerie was in love with the now- compleat Ayara
